$comment: The normative Device crypto contract (AD-12, AD-17, AD-25). Every label, size and header name here is generated into Rust, C# and Kotlin by scripts/generate.ts; no language types one by hand. Changing a value is a wire break: bump the label version instead.

purposeKeys.construction: HKDF-SHA256(salt = empty, ikm = K_dev, info = label, L = length)

deviceId.construction: HKDF-SHA256(salt = empty, ikm = K_dev, info = label, L = length); text form is lowercase hex
deviceId.label: device-id/v1

frame.keys: uplink frames are sealed with seal/v1, downlinks with ack/v1

enrolment.construction: RFC 9180 base mode, single-shot Seal at sequence 0: pt = K_dev, aad = device_id
enrolment.fingerprint: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte X25519 public key

setup.construction: okm = HKDF-SHA256(salt = UTF-8(uppercase PoP code), ikm = X25519(own, peer), info = label || app_pub || hub_pub, L = okmLength)
setup.label: coldframe/setup/v1
setup.code: the PoP code is ASCII, 1 to maxCodeLength characters; it is uppercased (ASCII only) before use
setup.wrongCode: the first message that fails to open means a wrong PoP code

heartbeat.canonical:
METHOD 
 PATH 
 hex(SHA-256(body)) 
 TIMESTAMP_MS 
 NONCE_HEX, lowercase hex, no trailing newline; METHOD is uppercase and PATH is the absolute request path without query string, exactly as sent (for example /device/heartbeat)
